title: Save the Date: Hero Walk-in (stylish, smooth)
story: A modern couple's save-the-date as a slow-motion hero entry from an action film: sunglasses, city lights, swagger, then the date.
script:
# Save the Date: Hero Walk-in (outline, written before the music)

**Ask (30 Oct 16:45):** "a stylish smooth save the date, who look like a hero in a movie."
**Idea:** the couple's entry shot from a big-screen action film. Slow motion, sunglasses, wind in the coat, the city behind them. Cool, confident and smooth, not loud for the sake of it. Built on the swagger of Dark Horse, which he liked, but smoother and warmer for a wedding.

| Time | Scene | Music |
|---|---|---|
| 0-4 s | Black. A lighter flicks; boots on wet tarmac. | One solo electric guitar, clean and smoky, plays the hook alone with slow bends. |
| 4-8 s | Two silhouettes walk out of the light in slow motion. | Deep 808 sub swells in, a finger snap and a low male hum join; tension rises. |
| 8 s | They lift their sunglasses. | One heavy, smooth slam: the full groove drops in. |
| 8-24 s | Slow-motion walk through the city, coat tails flying. | Laid-back swagger groove, deep sub, crisp snaps, the hook on a smooth synth lead with bends; a cool whistle answers. |
| 24-36 s | He offers his hand; she takes it with a smirk. | A soft female voice hums the hook over the groove; strings glide in underneath. |
| 36-37 s | Freeze frame. | A half-second stop. |
| 37-52 s | They turn to camera together, sparks and lights behind them. | The peak: the hook an octave higher on lead and strings, deep male chant answering, big but smooth drums. |
| 52-60 s | "SAVE THE DATE" and the date burn onto the screen. | Three cool full-band hits and the solo guitar plays the hook one last time over a deep boom that rings out. |

**Raga:** Kiravani in E (E minor with a raised 7th, the classic stylish hero colour). One key, one tempo, one hook, one continuous generation. No key change (v2's key lift broke the flow).

prompt: A stylish, smooth, swaggering modern hero-entry film score for a one-minute save-the-date film: the couple walks in like the heroes of a big-screen action movie, in slow motion. Cool, confident and classy, sleek rather than loud, with heavy deep bass and a smooth laid-back groove. Not sad, not dark horror, not EDM. One steady tempo, 92 BPM half-time swagger, never stopping except one half-second freeze. One key the whole way: Kiravani in E, E minor with a raised seventh (E F# G A B C D#). No key change. ONE original, cool 4-bar hook runs through the whole track: E G A B, A G F# D# E, played with raga-style bends and slides, coming back bigger each time. Written the way today's South Indian film composers score a stylish mass hero entry: swagger, smooth stop-and-slam hits, a male wordless chant answering the hook, a korvai-style ending. Sound: a clean smoky electric guitar, deep sustained 808 sub-bass, crisp finger snaps and tight drums, a smooth synth lead, a cool whistle, gliding strings, a soft wordless female humming voice and a deep male wordless chant. Real instruments are close, dry and natural, no heavy echo. 0-4 s: a solo clean electric guitar plays the hook alone with slow bends, smoky and cool. 4-8 s: a deep 808 sub swells in, finger snaps and a low male hum join, tension rising. 8 s: one heavy, smooth slam and the full groove drops in. 8-24 s: laid-back swagger groove, deep sub, crisp snaps, the hook on a smooth synth lead with bends, a cool whistle answers each phrase. 24-36 s: a soft female voice hums the hook over the groove, strings glide in underneath. 36-37 s: a half-second freeze, then straight back in. 37-52 s: the peak: the hook an octave higher on lead and strings, the deep male chant answering, big smooth drums, same key. 52-60 s: three cool full-band hits, then the solo guitar plays the hook one last time over a deep boom that rings out. No soft long intro, no fade-in, no fade-out, no EDM drop, no side-chain pumping, no white-noise risers, no clashing chords, no lyrics.
